metrics.method: Full history 2025-07-24 to 2026-09-24, 1087 non-service messages (547 client / 540 ALTR+vendor). Client = 'Eli' per config/clients.yaml; everyone else is our side. Client messages were grouped into 259 bursts (same forum topic, gaps under 6h); 67 bursts contained a question mark. 'Unanswered >24h' = no ALTR message in the same forum topic (reply chains resolved to their topic) within 24h of the burst's last message - 22 bursts, of which 2 were never answered at all, both from 2026-09-24. Median in-thread reply lag 13.2h, p75 74.9h, p90 187.4h. Max team silence = longest gap between consecutive ALTR messages (27.0 days, 2026-05-05 to 2026-06-01; runners-up 12.3d, 11.8d, 11.0d, plus a 5-day total silence 09-18 to 09-23). Promises = explicit first-person commitments by our side to do a specific thing ('I'll get you X', 'on it', 'I'll let you know when Y', named calls, announced recurring deliverables); counted 38, of which 14 were visibly delivered in-chat and 24 lapsed with no delivery and no explanation.

what_client_wanted: Her Instagram accounts kept alive and recovered when they die - her stated number-one priority for 350 days, and the thing she pays us for: 'All Instagram I gave you guys got deleted. Any news with recovery's?' (2026-08-30), and earlier 'Something weird is happening to my instagram, it's being locked "for security reasons or possible hack" ... Do you guys have any ideas how I could possibly solve it?' (2025-10-25).

Definitive answers about platform warnings - whether a flag actually endangers her account - not workarounds: 'Ok. Is it going to affect my account ? Or they just delete photos and that's it ?' (2026-01-28) and 'So I just tag someone and that's it ?' (2026-08-09).

(2025-09-09), 'Please let me know what content you guys need' (2025-10-03), 'What exactly you need , reels/ picks?' (2026-09-24).

Confirmation that her money landed and what we hold, without having to chase it: 'Lmk when it hits' (2026-09-09), 'Pls let me know all these was sent and didn't bounce back' (2026-09-08), and visibility into what she pays extra for: 'we increased the 5% for this month in order to try out the paid Instagram ads, I wanna know how it's going so far. Is there any statistics I can see?' (2025-11-18).
what_worked: DMCA takedowns run as a closed loop - Nick named the problem, gave an ETA ('ETA on these removals will be 2-8 days'), reported the outcome with a screenshot, and got the warmest praise on the account: 'Amazing thank you Nick great job 👏' (2025-12-11). That exact service has produced nothing for 205 days and the dedicated topic is dead.

A specific, named, concrete ask gets same-day delivery from this client. Ronnie posted 'pending customs above' with the live tracking sheet at 01:45 on 2026-09-23; she picked it up the next afternoon with 'I can make these done today' and posted the Dropbox folder 33 minutes later - 'Here the link', 'All done ☑️'. Nobody acknowledged it.

Staying in the thread in real time while a problem is live. Mica spent an hour with her through the October shadowban ('Don't worry the shadowban will go away in a few days as long as you removed the flagged posts', 'I'm here if anything else happens!!', 2025-10-10) and Sophie ran actual calls with written debriefs - 'Was a pleasure you so nice!! ❤️ thank you for sending this over too xx' (2025-09-18). Both cadences have since stopped.
top_fix: Give every open item on this account one named owner and force a dated status post from that owner even when the status is 'no progress' - because nothing here failed by doing the wrong thing, it failed by going quiet. The first instance is billing: within 24h of any wire, the owner posts 'Received $X on [date] from [sender], $Y credited to next invoice, balance $Z'. That one rule alone would have surfaced the $5,000 under-credit in a day instead of eight, would have closed out the $10,000 that has now sat unconfirmed for nine days against a beneficiary name we changed the day before, and would have made the second thing unavoidable: a named owner for the three deleted Instagram accounts, whose first status post has to be the one telling her that her own password is sitting in this chat twice and rotating it before she opens that message herself.
